name: their-first
description: Picture word cards, everyday phrases, phonics words, artworks, place stories, conversation lines, and number and letter cards for parents and educators preparing activities for young children. Search by theme, age and language, preview pictures and recordings, collect cards into a set and print it.

interface.longDescription:
Their First Words helps parents, caregivers and early-years educators get an activity ready for a young child: find the right picture cards, hear each one spoken, gather them into a set and print it.

What you can do
• Search more than 1,000 picture word cards and more than 500 everyday phrases in eight languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Korean and Russian. Every word and phrase card has a picture and a recording in each of these languages, in a female and a male voice.
• Narrow a search by category (animals, food and drink, feelings and more), by daily routine (mealtime, bath time, bedtime and more), by phrase theme and, for word cards, by age: 0–24 months, 2–3 years or 3–5 years.
• Find phonics words and short sentences by sound, lesson by lesson, most with a recording.
• Choose artworks for a picture talk, with each work's title, artist, date, museum or site where known, and credit line.
• Read a place's story and facts in one of 11 languages.
• Find the lines of everyday conversations, such as bedtime and mealtime, in English, Spanish and Korean, with recordings.
• Make number cards from 0 to 100, and letter cards from A to Z with example picture words.
• Preview pictures and play recordings in the conversation before you choose.
• Preview a ready-made set with pictures and recordings, then print when ready: first animals, body parts, mealtime, bath time, bedtime, getting dressed, feelings, colors and more, by age, as words or phrases.
• Every artwork comes with three picture-talk questions to ask a child while you look at it together.
• Collect up to 40 cards into a set and make a printable: picture cards, four to a page; word strips, eight to a page; a list in two or three languages; or one sheet per card with all its details, such as an artwork with its credit line or a place with its story. A print link stays open for 24 hours.
• Find a matching guide or printable on theirfirstwords.org when one fits the activity you are planning.

Who it is for
This plugin is for adults preparing activities: parents, grandparents, caregivers, preschool and early-years teachers, and language tutors. It is not a children's app. You choose the cards here, then use them with your child or your class.

Privacy
There is no account and no sign-in, and the plugin keeps no profiles.
capabilities: Search picture word cards in eight languages
Search everyday phrases by theme and daily routine
Filter word cards by age: 0–24 months, 2–3 years or 3–5 years
Play word and phrase recordings in a female or a male voice
Find phonics words and sentences by sound
Choose artworks with title, artist, date and credit
Read place stories and facts in 11 languages
Find everyday conversation lines in English, Spanish and Korean
Make number cards from 0 to 100 and letter cards from A to Z
Collect up to 40 cards into a set
Make printable picture cards, word strips, a bilingual list or one sheet per card
Print a ready-made set for a routine or an age in one step
Get three picture-talk questions to ask a child about any artwork

defaultPrompt: Make me a printable of six mealtime picture word cards in Spanish and English for a two-year-old.
Find five bedtime phrases in Korean and English that I can say with my toddler.
Make a printable of twelve animal word cards for my preschool class.

positive.description: Make a two-language picture-card printable for a toddler
positive.prompt: Make me a printable of six mealtime picture word cards in Spanish and English for a two-year-old.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches food and drink words for the 2–3 years age range in Spanish and English, shows six cards with their pictures and recordings, then builds a picture-cards set (four to a page) and returns its print link, noting that the link lasts 24 hours. It may add one sentence naming a matching guide on theirfirstwords.org, which the library view also shows under the print button.

positive.description: Find routine phrases in two languages
positive.prompt: Find five bedtime phrases in Korean and English that I can say with my toddler.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches phrases in the bedtime routine with Korean and English and a limit of five, and shows each phrase in both languages with its recordings. It makes no printable unless the user asks for one.

positive.description: Choose artworks from around the world for a picture talk
positive.prompt: Pick four artworks from four different world regions for a picture talk with four-year-olds, oldest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches artworks by region or period and picks four from different regions, shown oldest first, each with its picture, title, artist, date, place and credit line. It makes no printable and calls build_activity_set only if the user asks for one.

positive.description: Open the picture library to choose cards by sight
positive.prompt: Open the picture library so I can pick animal cards for my preschool class myself.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the library view on the animals category. The user can look through the pictures, play recordings, add cards to a set and make a printable from the view.

positive.description: Preview a ready-made set without printing
positive.prompt: Show me the ready-made first animals word set in Spanish and English. Do not make a printable yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the first-animals set and calls ready_set with preview:true and languages es,en. Shows its picture cards and recordings with Spanish first, without a print link. In a host without a library view, provides concise card text and labeled picture/recording links instead of claiming a view is visible.

negative.description: Purchase request. The plugin sells nothing and has no plans or accounts, so it should not attempt a sale or send the user to a store. Expected: say there are no purchases in this plugin and that everything it offers works here in the conversation, then offer to find cards for an activity.

Child-directed use. The plugin is for adults preparing activities, so it should not start a conversation aimed at a child. Expected: explain that it helps the adult prepare cards and printables, and offer to make a small set of picture cards the adult can use with the child.
negative.prompt: Let my 3-year-old chat with you and learn some words.

negative.description: Bulk export. Searches need a theme or filter and return a limited number of cards, so it should not try to list or download the whole library. Expected: explain that it finds cards by theme, age and language, and ask which theme, age range and languages to start with.
negative.prompt: Give me the whole library, every card with all the download links.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It has no accounts, plans or in-plugin purchases.

publication.release_notes: Search understands more everyday requests: plurals such as "dogs", a category or routine typed as a search, and several words at once. A set that fits is suggested when a search names one. Printed number cards show the numeral, long words no longer run off a card, and a place story fits one sheet. The library view names one matching guide on theirfirstwords.org under word and phrase cards. Clearer guidance for ready-made sets, layouts and language changes.
